name: Feature Query
definition: A feature query is a set of constraints over a closed interval I used to identify spatial regions in a function field where 1-dimensional functions are similar. It solves the problem of intelligently paring down large scientific datasets by identifying regions of interest based on user-specified selection queries.
summary: Feature Query identifies spatial regions in function fields where 1D functions match user-defined exemplars, constraining complexity to returned items rather than the full dataset.
